'''T.J. Holman DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[T.J. Holman]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-6476">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6476 DeckTech post 6476], DeckTech (TJ "Techmaster" Holman, 9 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6476/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6476/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018172418/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6476/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[T.J. Holman]]
* '''Published:''' 9 May 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Any Methods Necessary|ECC-D-anymethodsnecessary.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Vile Holman DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]

== Original post ==

'''Dirty Sanchez'''
* '''Author:''' TJ "Techmaster" Holman
* '''Published:''' May 9, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' A court deck that is really good and not like all the ass youve seen.

=== Strategy ===

Start with methods and pull zuck, his ship and the tower. Turn one set up your activation by pulling a docking bay and dropping the tower and pulling jabba.  Set your @#$% up with presence for increased force loss and activation and dont let em come ton one of the only TWO tatooine sites they can occupy.  Let a walker or two sit in the great pit and vader, saber, tarkin, jabba, boelo and you are beaten hang in the chamber. your loss will be so much you can just ignore them.
